text: Recently my office has received two separate requests from Bain Avenue, one from residents asking for expanded parking options, and one from Withrow Public School looking to expand the times for their Pick-Up and Drop-Off times to better match the realities of the school day. Transportation Services has indicated that there is a solution that I believe will satisfy all parties. This involves a relocation of the Pick-Up and Drop-Off Zone to the same side as the school (improving safety for the children) and allowing residents to park normally on the north side of the street. This will be accompanied by an expansion of the permitted Pick-Up and Drop-Off hours.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York, to report to the April 4, 2018 meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council on: a. switching the Pick-Up and Drop-Off area for Withrow Public School from the north side of Bain Avenue to the south side of Bain Avenue; b. extending the times of the Pick-Up and Drop-Off Area to 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, except July, August and Public Holidays; and c. the addition of Parking Islands on Bain Avenue between Broadview Avenue and Ingham Avenue to increase parking supply.
